model.title: Continental Divide National Scenic Trail Completion Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Martin Heinrich (D-NM)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Department of Agriculture and Department of the Interior to work together to complete the Continental Divide National Scenic Trail within 10 years. It requires the agencies to establish a joint team to coordinate completion efforts, develop a comprehensive plan for the trail within three years, and partner with volunteer and nonprofit organizations to help finish and maintain it.
